reason: NONE. The first thing I saw was the big "200 mg" on the front, and then I realized it is two capsules in each sachet, so it is 100 mg a capsule, which is what I figured. The sachets are handy for travel and the QR batch report is a nice touch, but there are no reviews and no NSF or USP seal, and I stick with Pure Encapsulations or Thorne.
objection: It is a brand nobody has reviewed yet and the box has no NSF or USP seal, only their own QR report. I would be paying about a dollar a day to be the guinea pig when I already have a magnesium I trust on Subscribe & Save.
would_change_my_mind: An NSF or USP certification on the box, plus a few hundred real verified reviews. A small trial size that I could try on one trip would also help.
